GOLD HAS CRASHED BELOW $4,000.

SILVER GETTINg SMASHED.

THE US DOLLAR HAS HIT A 19-MONTH HIGH.

THE US 10-YEAR TREASURY YIELD BRIEFLY BROKE 5%.

AND HERE'S THE WILD PART.

THE MARKET IS SELLING GOLD....THE SO-CALLED INFLATION HEDGE...BECAUSE INFLATION IS TOO HIGH!!!

LET THAT SINK IN.

This is something I think a LOT of traders fundamentally misunderstand.

US inflation just came in HOTTER than expected.

Headline CPI: 0.4% vs 0.3% expected.

Core CPI: 0.3% vs 0.2% expected.

The reaction...

GOLD HAMMERED.

SILVER HAMMERED.

TREASURY YIELDS SURGING.

THE DOLLAR RIPPING HIGHER.

And the Fed is now effectively priced to raise interest rates in December.

BUT WHY IS GOLD FALLING WHEN INFLATION IS RISING?

Isn't gold supposed to protect against inflation?

YES. But it's not that simple.

The market isn't just looking at inflation.

IT'S LOOKING AT WHAT THE FED IS GOING TO DO ABOUT IT.

And that's where everything changes.

Hotter inflation increases the pressure on the Fed to raise rates.

Bond yields rise as markets reprice those expectations.

The US dollar becomes more attractive.

And suddenly, holding an asset that pays ZERO interest becomes less appealing.

Especially when REAL YIELDS are rising.

NOW LOOK AT SILVER.

Silver has the added complication of being an industrial metal.

So alongside higher yields and a stronger dollar, traders also have to consider what tighter monetary policy could mean for economic activity and industrial demand.

THAT'S WHY SILVER CAN GET HIT EVEN HARDER.

And here's another interesting development.

WHILE GOLD WAS GETTING SOLD YESTERDAY...

THE S&P 500 RALLIED MORE THAN 1%.

THINK ABOUT THAT.

Equities finding buyers.

Precious metals struggling.

The dollar strengthening.

This isn't simply a market running away from risk.

IT'S A MARKET REPRICING THE COST OF MONEY.

Now here's where my attention turns.

Gold has lost that crucial $4,000 area.

The recent bullish reversal has stalled.

And the risk of another lower low is becoming increasingly relevant.

But I'm NOT writing off gold's longer-term bullish case.

Because if the inflation picture changes, the Fed repricing reverses and real yields start coming down?

GOLD COULD BECOME VERY INTERESTING AGAIN.

The question is WHEN.

Not every sell-off is a buying opportunity.

And not every breakdown is the start of a bear market.

I want to see what the dollar and bond market do next.

Especially with US PPI due tomorrow.

HERE IS MY QUESTION TRADERS....

IS THIS GOLD AND SILVER SELL-OFF CREATING ONE OF THE BIGGEST BUYING OPPORTUNITIES OF THE YEAR?

OR ARE PRECIOUS METALS WARNING US THAT THERE'S A MUCH BIGGER CORRECTION STILL TO COME?

INSANE REVERSAL

SpaceX has just officially announced plans to invest more than $74 billion to build two massive AI supercomputing facilities in Texas and Arizona.

• $24 billion facility near Starbase, Texas
• $50 billion campus in Cochise County, Arizona
• More than 10,000 construction jobs
• Over 1,500 permanent jobs
• $220 million investment in Brownsville water infrastructure

The facilities will train advanced AI systems and help develop technologies for future space-based computing.

Shawn Mendes speaks out in support of Palestine: 

“My friends and fellow artists, I know it can feel scary to speak up; I feel it now as I type this... I also feel the need to do something to help. The more of us that use our voice, the closer we are to change. If you agree please search your heart, find your courage and do what you can to help. These children in Palestine have had to be brave for too long. It’s our turn to do the same now.”

DeMarcus Cousins calls out Jayson Tatum for being performative by trying to interact with Jaylen Brown before the game

“I feel like Jaylen Brown, with the words that he said, he’s kind of made it clear, like, we’re not cool. There’s nothing to really talk about. We’re not cool. So, to me, it was a bit performative. It was almost like, let me be the good guy in the spotlight while I can make him look like the bad guy in the spotlight. At the end of the day, if you can’t have a conversation in private, why have an interaction in public?”

(Via @RunItBackFDTV )

The Russo Bros tease Doctor Doom in 'Avengers: Doomsday' 

“Doom is a Gothic character. He says, ‘Hell answers to me,’ and he’s not kidding. He’s a very powerful character with some very dark magic, and he’s not above selling his soul to get what he wants. He’s worth being scared of"

"He’s a father who’s a victim of trauma. He has lost a child. When people see the film they say it’s a very scary movie. It’s scary because he’s so profoundly damaged"

“Doom is much more ego-driven than Thanos. Thanos believed he was serving a greater good"

(via @empiremagazine)

🚨🇮🇷🇺🇸 EXPLOSIONS are being reported in SIRIK, along Iran's strategically important Strait of Hormuz coastline.

The area has already experienced several unexplained blasts in recent days, due to renewed American strikes on Iranian military positions.

Sirik sits close to the shipping corridor where Washington is enforcing its blockade and Iranian forces are challenging commercial vessels.

For now, it's unclear what caused the latest reported explosions, whether any targets were hit or whether U.S. forces were involved.

Source: GeoPolitics Watch on TG / Writer: Oliver

🇺🇸🇨🇳 Jensen Huang has AGREED to testify before House Republicans as the Chinese espionage scandal surrounding NVIDIA continues to grow.

The former NVIDIA CEO will face lawmakers who were preparing to SUBPOENA him if he refused to cooperate.

They want answers about his relationship with a woman suspected of working for Chinese intelligence, and whether sensitive American AI technology was put at risk.

Three Republican committee chairmen have demanded explanations about NVIDIA's security protocols and its dealings with companies linked to China.

Huang has denied knowingly compromising national security, and NVIDIA's board has said it found no reason to believe company secrets were exposed.

But the questions have moved well beyond his private life.

Congress wants to know what China may have gained access to, and whether NVIDIA's safeguards were enough to stop it.

Source: Fox News / Writer: Oliver

🚨🇺🇸 UPDATE: Police seek HEAVYSET MAN IN GRAY SHORTS with FIREARM

A heavily built white man wearing gray shorts and reportedly carrying a gray-and-black gun is the suspect police are searching for.

A small fire was also seen at the Logan Circle building where the gunman is believed to be barricaded.

Authorities have not confirmed the cause of the fire or whether the suspect remains inside...

Source: NBC / Writer: Marie
